ratings-aux-G2-waterink-style-harbor.jso.rater: auxiliary vision model gemini-3-flash-preview via the project auxiliary API
ratings-aux-G2-waterink-style-harbor.jso.role: second-pass rater; the agent's own vision pass remains primary
ratings-aux-G2-waterink-style-harbor.jso.limits: scores cells the agent has not read by eye; evidence is one sentence per cell and is the only basis accepted; malformed or missing cells stay unrated
ratings-aux-G2-waterink-style-harbor.jso.sheet: cell numbering 1..N in reading order, rows = seed, cols = groups A-F

ratings-dual.json.sheets: analysis/sheets/dual-all.png (all 30 cells), analysis/sheets/dual-zoom.png and dual-zoom2.png (full-size checks of the waterink, sakurapion, renian, fuzichoco and tinkle H cells)
ratings-dual.json.protocol: G = the content image alone; H = [content image, style reference] with <image1>/<image2> role separation in the text. Content retention is judged against the content image itself (refs/content.jpg), not against the harbour/cafe baselines.
ratings-dual.json.note: the content image contains a single standing/seated woman in a blue interior; there is no person in the still-life sense here, so 'content' means identity, dress, pose and setting of that woman

scale.style_0_5: rendering-technique movement toward the style reference vs. the same style's G output
scale.content_0_5: the content image's subject, dress and setting preserved
scale.leakage_0_5: 0 = nothing of the style reference's own subject/scene/decor; 5 = the reference content replaced the requested content

ratings-harbor-cafe-s42.json.sheets: blind-harbor-s42.png (blind, revealed after first pass); facet-harbor-*.png; facet-cafe-allseeds.png; zoom-*-CEDF.png; cafe-*.png; sd-*-harbor.png
ratings-harbor-cafe-s42.json.protocol: harbor seed 42 scored blind (X01-X30) then unblinded; the remaining seed-42 cells scored from labelled comparison sheets read at full thumbnail detail; cross-seed cells scored from the facet/sd sheets
ratings-harbor-cafe-s42.json.evidence_codes: E1..E14 — see analysis/evidence-codes.md; each code expands to the visible observations behind the scores

scale.style_0_5: rendering-technique movement toward the reference (line, colouring, light, texture, figure abstraction) vs. the A baseline of the same style/subject/seed
scale.content_0_5: requested identity, hair/eye colour, outfit, props, setting, object counts
scale.leakage_0_5: 0 = nothing of the reference's subject/scene/decor; 5 = reference content replaced the requested content

ratings-harbor-s42.json.sheet: harbor seed 42 (proxy for smoke's 30 images; identical requests, generated once)
ratings-harbor-s42.json.protocol: scored blind from analysis/sheets/blind-harbor-s42.png with labels X01-X30 only; job mapping revealed from the .KEY.json only after every cell was scored

scale.style_0_5: how far the rendering technique (line, colouring, light, texture, figure abstraction) moved toward the reference vs. the A baseline
scale.content_0_5: subject identity, hair/eye colour, outfit, props, setting, object counts
scale.leakage_0_5: 0 = nothing from the reference image's subject/scene/decor; 5 = reference content replaced the requested content
scale.quality_0_5: completion quality: anatomy, coherence, artefacts, single-panel integrity

ratings-rest-seeds.json.protocol: primary vision pass 4. Each style+subject was read as one comparison sheet (rows = the two extra seeds, columns = groups A-F) from analysis/rate-sheets/. The table below is the judgement written per (style, subject, mode); the DEVIATIONS list marks the cells that were scored differently from that base because the sheet showed a different outcome. Seeds are separately scored, so cross-seed spread is real data, not a copy.

ratings-still_life-s42.json.sheets: still-waterink.png, still-waterink-C.png, still-sakura.png, still-fuzichoco-v2.png, still-tinkle-style.png, still-renian.png, facet-still_life-*.png
ratings-still_life-s42.json.protocol: direct close reading of the still-life block (all 5 styles x 6 groups x 3 seeds) plus zoomed group sheets; not blind — the still-life subject is unambiguous, so the decisive question is the simple one: does a person appear in a picture whose prompt says no person
ratings-still_life-s42.json.key_test: the still-life prompt says 'No person, no face, no human silhouette'. Any human figure in these cells is therefore leakage by definition, not a drawing choice

scale.style_0_5: rendering-technique movement toward the reference vs. the A baseline
scale.content_0_5: teapot + blue cup + two lemons + table + window + sea all present and countable
scale.leakage_0_5: 0 = nothing of the reference's subject/scene/decor; 5 = the reference content replaced the requested content
